packageRules.description: The Dockerfile build stages (node:24-trixie-slim), the distroless runtime (nodejs24-debian13) and the node-version in ci.yml must stay on the same Node line, since native add-ons built in one are loaded in the other. A major bump is coordinated by hand with whatever distroless nodejs variant is available.
scout-action 1.25+ rejects tokens made from a Docker Hub personal access token, which broke publishing on 2026-10-15. Remove once DOCKERHUB_TOKEN is replaced with a token Scout accepts (see ci.yml).
